name: Air Asia Co., Ltd.
summary: Air Asia Co., Ltd. operates as an aircraft maintenance company in Taiwan and internationally. It offers civilian and military aircraft maintenance, engine and component maintenance, helicopter maintenance, and aeronautical parts asset management services; and commercial and military aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul services comprising A/B/C/D checks, airworthiness directives/service bulletins, CPCP/SSID, structure damage repair, and airframe modification and retrofit services. The company also provides engine and component maintenance services, such as engine and component repair and overhaul, precision measurement, and non-destructive inspection services.
